# `silk/platform/wasm/support`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The C library of every wasm32 executable: the heap entry points and the byte routines.

## When to use
The standard library's catalog names this module as the wasm32 targets' support module, so
every wasm32 executable links its C exports, whatever its runtime. Sealed core storage and
LLVM's lowering call `malloc`, `free`, `memcpy` and the rest, and WebAssembly has no libc to
supply them. Applications do not call these functions.

## Details
The heap functions forward to `WasmHeap`. LLVM expands its own copies and fills into
`memory.copy` and `memory.fill`, so the byte routines serve only calls by name: an unoptimized
build's sealed storage calls. `memmove` handles overlapping ranges, so it implements `memcpy`
too.

## Gotchas
These C exports are link symbols only: unlike other C exports on WebAssembly, the module does
not export them to its host.
